name: tool-search
description: Intent-based search over the tool catalogue. Given a natural-language query describing what you want to do, returns the top-ranked tool manifests (full JSON). Use before guessing a run command.
use_when: finding the right tool for a task by describing intent

args.name: query
args.description: Search terms describing what you want to do.

args.name: --select
args.description: Comma-separated tool names; returns their full manifests exactly.

args.name: --names-only
args.description: Print ranked names and scores only.

stdout: JSON array of matching tool manifests (or ranked name list with --names-only).
